info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Card Collection-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of card collections within the banking operational services framework. It enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and organize multiple card accounts, enhancing operational efficiency and customer service. Typical consumers include banking application developers and financial service providers looking to streamline card management processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure a structured approach to card collection operations, leading to improved client experiences and operational agility.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new card collection within the operational services framework. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully establish a new collection.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new card collection within the operational services. It requires specific parameters to be provided in JSON format that define the properties and characteristics of the card collection being created.

201.description: The card collection resource was successfully created.
